description: This file implements the UserIdManager class, which manages user IDs for applications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for assigning, clearing, and retrieving user IDs, as well as defining the UID range and GID for applications.

classes.name: UserIdManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing user IDs for applications, including allocation, deallocation, and range management.

methods.name: UserIdManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the user ID pool within a specified range.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns a user ID for a given application ID, allocating from the pool if necessary.

methods.name: clearUserId
methods.description: Releases the user ID associated with an application ID back to the pool.

methods.name: getAppsUidRange
methods.description: Returns the range of UIDs allocated for applications.

methods.name: getAppsGid
methods.description: Returns the GID associated with application UIDs.
